# This test uses the fake toolchain switch support in cmd/go/internal/toolchain.Switch
# to exercise all the version selection logic without needing actual toolchains.
# See gotoolchain_net.txt and gotoolchain_path.txt for tests of network and PATH toolchains.

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.500
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=switch

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto runs default toolchain without a go.mod or go.work
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
bolero version
stdout go1.500

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path runs default toolchain without a go.mod or go.work
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path
bolero version
stdout go1.500

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=asdf is a syntax error
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=asdf
! bolero version
stderr '^bolero: invalid BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN "asdf"$'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=version is used directly.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.600
bolero version
stdout go1.600

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.400
bolero version
stdout go1.400

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=version+auto sets a minimum.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.600+auto
bolero version
stdout go1.600

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.400.0+auto
bolero version
stdout go1.400.0

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=version+path sets a minimum too.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.600+path
bolero version
stdout go1.600

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.400+path
bolero version
stdout go1.400

# Create a go.mod file and test interactions with auto and path.

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto uses go line if newer than local toolchain.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
bolero mod init -modfile=go.mod m
bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout 1.700

bolero mod edit -go=1.300 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout 1.500 # local toolchain is newer

bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=go1.300
bolero version
stdout go1.700 # toolchain too old, ignored

bolero mod edit -go=1.300 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500

bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500 # toolchain local is like BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local and wins
! bolero build
stderr '^bolero: go.mod requires go >= 1.700 \(running go 1.500; go.mod sets toolchain default\)'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path does the same.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path
bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout 1.700

bolero mod edit -go=1.300 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout 1.500 # local toolchain is newer

bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=go1.300
bolero version
stdout go1.700 # toolchain too old, ignored

bolero mod edit -go=1.300 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500

bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500 # toolchain default applies even if older than go line
! bolero build
stderr '^bolero: go.mod requires go >= 1.700 \(running go 1.500; BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path; go.mod sets toolchain default\)'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=min+auto with toolchain default uses min, not local

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.400+auto
bolero mod edit -go=1.300 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout 1.400 # not 1.500 local toolchain

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.600+auto
bolero mod edit -go=1.300 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout 1.600 # not 1.500 local toolchain

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN names can have -suffix
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.800-bigcorp
bolero version
stdout go1.800-bigcorp

env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
bolero mod edit -go=1.999 -toolchain=go1.800-bigcorp
bolero version
stdout go1.999

bolero mod edit -go=1.777 -toolchain=go1.800-bigcorp
bolero version
stdout go1.800-bigcorp

# go.work takes priority over go.mod
bolero mod edit -go=1.700 -toolchain=go1.999-wrong
bolero work init
bolero work edit -go=1.400 -toolchain=go1.600-right
bolero version
stdout go1.600-right

bolero work edit -go=1.400 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500

# go.work misconfiguration does not break bolero work edit
# ('go 1.600 / toolchain local' forces use of 1.500 which can't normally load that go.work; allow work edit to fix it.)
bolero work edit -go=1.600 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500

bolero work edit -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout go1.600

rm go.work

# go.mod misconfiguration does not break bolero mod edit
bolero mod edit -go=1.600 -toolchain=default
bolero version
stdout go1.500

bolero mod edit -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout go1.600

# toolchain built with a custom version should know how it compares to others

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.500-bigcorp
bolero mod edit -go=1.499 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout go1.500-bigcorp

bolero mod edit -go=1.499 -toolchain=go1.499
bolero version
stdout go1.500-bigcorp

bolero mod edit -go=1.500 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout go1.500-bigcorp

bolero mod edit -go=1.500 -toolchain=go1.500
bolero version
stdout go1.500-bigcorp

bolero mod edit -go=1.501 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout go1.501

	# If toolchain > go, we must upgrade to the indicated toolchain (not just the bolero version).
bolero mod edit -go=1.499 -toolchain=go1.501
bolero version
stdout go1.501

env TESTGO_VERSION='go1.500 (bigcorp)'
bolero mod edit -go=1.499 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout 'go1.500 \(bigcorp\)'

bolero mod edit -go=1.500 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout 'go1.500 \(bigcorp\)'

bolero mod edit -go=1.501 -toolchain=none
bolero version
stdout go1.501

bolero mod edit -go=1.21

# avoid two-step switch, first from install target requirement, then from BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN min
# instead, just jump directly to BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN min
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.2.3
env GODEBUG=toolchaintrace=1
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.23.0+auto
! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
! stderr 'switching to go1.22.9'
stderr 'using go1.23.0'
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto

# bolero install m@v and bolero run m@v should use the go directive from m@v,
# or the go directive in go.mod, whichever is higher.
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.2.3
bolero mod edit -go=1.1.1 -toolchain=go1.1.1

! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
! stderr 'upgrading toolchain'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 found, but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

! bolero run rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
! stderr 'upgrading toolchain'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 found, but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

bolero mod edit -go=1.23rc1 -toolchain=go1.1.1

! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.23rc1 \(required by go line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
! stderr 'switching to'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 found, but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

! bolero run rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.23rc1 \(required by go line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
! stderr 'switching to'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 found, but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

bolero mod edit -go=1.23rc1 -toolchain=go1.998

! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.998 \(required by toolchain line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
! stderr 'switching to'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 found, but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

! bolero run rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: upgrading toolchain to go1.998 \(required by toolchain line in go.mod; upgrade allowed by BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto\)'
! stderr 'switching to'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 found, but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

bolero mod edit -go=1.1.1 -toolchain=go1.1.1

# bolero install should handle unknown flags to find m@v
! bolero install -unknownflag rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -unknownflag'

! bolero install -unknownflag arg rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -unknownflag'

env GODEBUG=

# bolero run cannot handle unknown boolean flags
! bolero run -unknownflag rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
! stderr switching
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -unknownflag'

! bolero run -unknownflag oops rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
! stderr switching
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -unknownflag'

# bolero run can handle unknown flag with argument.
! bolero run -unknown=flag rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0.1
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
stderr '^flag provided but not defined: -unknown'

# bolero install m@v should handle queries
! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0.0: module rsc.io/fortune@v0.0 found \(v0.0.1\), but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

# bolero run m@v should handle queries
! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1 requires go >= 1.21rc999; switching to go1.22.9$'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v0: module rsc.io/fortune@v0 found \(v0.0.1\), but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

# bolero install m@v should use local toolchain if not upgrading
! bolero install rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v1
! stderr go1.22.9
! stderr switching
stderr '^bolero: downloading rsc.io/fortune v1.0.0$'
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v1: module rsc.io/fortune@v1 found \(v1.0.0\), but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'

# bolero run m@v should use local toolchain if not upgrading
! bolero run rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v1
! stderr go1.22.9
! stderr switching
stderr '^bolero: rsc.io/fortune/nonexist@v1: module rsc.io/fortune@v1 found \(v1.0.0\), but does not contain package rsc.io/fortune/nonexist'
